title: Sebastian and the Terminal
author: Tamsin Winterbourne
blurb: Edmund Eriksen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
